scope_note: SG-MA-CDTM-RETAIL after a further correction following the V10ZD audit. Vaccines: orientation[10], comparison_tables[1] rows 6-7, decision_logic[8] and the vaccine item in forms_records now say that on the reading where the clause (5) disease list reaches vaccines, the words "prescribed by the supervising physician for" attach, and give the course that meets the narrowest reading (the agreement authorizes vaccines and names the disease state, the patient is a referred, notified, consenting adult, and the supervising physician prescribed the vaccine for that condition or identified co-morbidity); a vaccine without that prescription or unrelated to a named condition rests on 247 CMR 16.03(5)(b) and 243 CMR 2.12(4)(e)2., which the statute may not support (s. 24B3/4). Extension: decision_logic[5] and its table row now list the Department registration and prescriptive practice guidelines (247 CMR 16.03(5)(e)1.; 105 CMR 700.003(G)(2)). Cross-reference: the places quoting s. 24B1/2(d) keep the statute's words and note that the current regulation places health facility registration at 105 CMR 700.004(A)(3)(d). New rules: MA-CDTM-RETAIL-VACCINE-LIMB-READINGS and MA-DPH-HEALTH-FACILITY-REGISTRATION-NUMBERING; MA-CDTM-PRESCRIBING-REGISTRATION is now cited. Scope gate: every actionable signal declined; besides the three 105 CMR 700.003 neighbours declined before, the new signals are 105 CMR 700.004 neighbours for other routes (pharmacist administration, the emergency vaccine order, hormonal contraception, naloxone and expedited partner therapy) taught in other sections. All four practice links stay.
